title: Genesis 22:13 — The ram caught in the thicket
summary: Genesis 22:13 in English with the Hebrew reference header: Abraham sees a ram caught in the thicket by its horns and offers it as a burnt offering in the place of his son. Abraham, thicket and son are colour-highlighted.

text.text: 13 Then Abraham raised his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns; and Abraham went and took the ram and offered him up for a burnt offering in the place of his son.

keywords: in the place of his son
